easyPrerequisites: Fiend Hunter must be exiled by Yannik, and Abdel Adrian must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Abdel Adrian for its mana cost.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it exiles Yannik until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Abdel Adrian's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Abdel Adrian until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
